eurostat_cod.notes: Vital-registration deaths from assault, not police-recorded crime. Datasets: hlth_cd_asdr2 (annual age-standardised death rate per 100,000, 2011-2023, by NUTS 2 region of residence; age groups total / under 65 / 65 and over), hlth_cd_acdr2 (annual crude death rate per 100,000, 2011-2023, by age group), hlth_cd_yro (number of deaths, 3-year average, 2013-2023, by residence/occurrence categories), hlth_cd_ysdr2 and hlth_cd_ycdr2 (3-year average standardised and crude rates, 2013-2023), and where published the historical series hlth_cd_acdr, hlth_cd_ysdr1, hlth_cd_ycdrt/f/m, hlth_cd_ynrt/f/m (1994-2010). Eurostat metadata (hlth_cdeath_sims): 3-year averages are 'the average of year, year -1 and year -2'; crude death rate is 'expressed in deaths per 100 000 inhabitants'. Every sex, age group and residence category Eurostat publishes is kept (overlapping age groups included as published). Eurostat flag 'd' = 'definition differs (see metadata)', kept in the breakdown text. Empty cells are not in the files (SDMX-CSV lists only published observations). Raw per-country extracts in raw/eurostat/.
